title: Shin Hati
description: Shin Hati was the intense apprentice of Baylan Skoll. She was adept at combat in a starfighter as well as with a Lightsaber and put those skills to work as a mercenary. Along with her Master, she hired herself out to Morgan Elsbeth in her efforts to build the Eye of Sion to reach a distant galaxy. She found herself abandoned by Skoll on the distant planet of Peridea while he sought a mysterious power.
